repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

draft.description: For a pull, make it a draft, or with false mark it ready to merge. Left as it is, when absent; any other item refuses it.

title.description: A pull's or an issue's new title.

images.description: Pictures uploaded with dev.knotless.uploadImage for the new body. Of these and those it had, the new body's links decide which stay attached.

subject.description: The pull, issue or comment to change.

addReviewers.description: For a pull, accounts to ask to review it, besides those it asks already. Any other item refuses it.

removeReviewers.description: For a pull, accounts to stop asking to review it. Any other item refuses it.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

main.description: Rewrites a dev.knotless.pull, dev.knotless.issue or dev.knotless.comment record in the account logged in to this appview's web pages, which must have written it, as `knotless pull edit` does: a pull's or an issue's title or body, or a comment's body, and whether a pull is a draft. An empty body takes a pull's or an issue's away; a comment keeps one. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets.

reviewer.description: An account asked, or no longer asked, to review a pull.

description: Changes what a pull, an issue or a comment says, as its author, logged in to this appview's pages.
